exams.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level Examinations
exams.blurb: Subject-by-subject Cambridge qualifications taken in some US high schools and accepted by many American universities for admission and course credit.

exams.name: CLEP American Government
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on US constitutional government, institutions, civil liberties and political behaviour, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP American Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering American prose, poetry and drama from the colonial period to the present, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Analyzing and Interpreting Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test using passages from American and British literature to assess close reading, interpretation and literary terminology.

exams.name: CLEP Biology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering molecular and cellular biology, organismal biology and population biology, commonly worth six college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Calculus
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test weighted about 60 percent limits and differential calculus and 40 percent integral calculus, typically worth four credits.

exams.name: CLEP Chemistry
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering the content of a full year of general chemistry, including stoichiometry, bonding, equilibrium and thermodynamics.

exams.name: CLEP College Algebra
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on algebraic operations, equations, inequalities, functions and their graphs at one-semester college algebra level.

exams.name: CLEP College Composition
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam writing test combining multiple-choice questions with two essays scored by College Board readers, often worth six credits.

exams.name: CLEP College Composition Modular
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice version of the CLEP composition exam that lets institutions add their own locally scored essay component if they wish.

exams.name: CLEP College Mathematics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of quantitative literacy for non-mathematics majors, covering logic, sets, probability, statistics and financial mathematics.

exams.name: CLEP English Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test focused on major British authors and works from Beowulf to the twentieth century, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Financial Accounting
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on the accounting cycle, financial statements, assets, liabilities and equity taught in introductory financial accounting.

exams.name: CLEP French Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of French listening and reading that can award Level 1 or Level 2 credit depending on the score achieved.

exams.name: CLEP German Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of German listening and reading comprehension awarding Level 1 or Level 2 college credit based on the score band reached.

exams.name: CLEP History of the United States I: Early Colonization to 1877
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering US history from early European colonisation through the Civil War and the end of Reconstruction in 1877.

exams.name: CLEP History of the United States II: 1865 to the Present
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering US history from the end of the Civil War through industrialisation, the world wars and the modern era.

exams.name: CLEP Human Growth and Development
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on theories and research in physical, cognitive and social development across the human lifespan.

exams.name: CLEP Humanities
exams.blurb: Broad credit-by-exam test of general knowledge in literature, visual art, music, philosophy and the performing arts from classical to modern times.

exams.name: CLEP Information Systems
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on hardware, software, networks, databases, security and the role of information systems in business organisations.

exams.name: CLEP Introduction to Educational Psychology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on cognition, child development, teaching methods, motivation and classroom assessment for education majors.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Business Law
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering contracts, torts, agency, the history and sources of American law and the legal environment of business.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Psychology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of the facts, concepts and accepted principles taught in a one-semester introductory college psychology course.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Sociology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering social institutions, stratification, culture, deviance and sociological research methods and theory.

exams.name: CLEP Natural Sciences
exams.blurb: Survey credit-by-exam test for non-science majors spanning biological and physical sciences, commonly worth six college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Precalculus
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of algebraic, exponential, logarithmic and trigonometric functions and their properties, graphs and applications.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Macroeconomics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering aggregate demand and supply, national income accounting, inflation, unemployment and monetary and fiscal policy.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Management
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on planning, organising, leading and controlling, human resources and operational aspects of management.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Marketing
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on consumer and organisational markets, segmentation, marketing strategy and the four elements of the marketing mix.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Microeconomics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on the economic principles governing individual consumers and firms, market structures, pricing and factor markets.

exams.name: CLEP Social Sciences and History
exams.blurb: Broad credit-by-exam test spanning history, economics, government, geography, sociology, psychology and anthropology, often worth six credits.

exams.name: CLEP Spanish Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of Spanish listening and reading comprehension awarding Level 1 or Level 2 college credit based on score.

exams.name: CLEP Spanish with Writing
exams.blurb: Extended CLEP Spanish exam that adds scored writing tasks to the listening and reading sections for higher-level language credit.

exams.name: CLEP Western Civilization I: Ancient Near East to 1648
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering the ancient Near East, Greece and Rome, the Middle Ages, the Renaissance and the Reformation up to 1648.

exams.name: CLEP Western Civilization II: 1648 to the Present
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering European history from the mid-seventeenth century through the world wars and the post-1945 period.

exams.name: DSST A History of the Vietnam War
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering the origins, escalation, conduct and aftermath of the Vietnam War, normally worth three credits.

exams.name: DSST Art of the Western World
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test surveying Western art and architecture from classical Greece through twentieth-century movements.

exams.name: DSST Astronomy
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the solar system, stellar evolution, galaxies and cosmology at introductory college level.

exams.name: DSST Business Ethics and Society
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on ethical theory, corporate social responsibility, governance and stakeholder issues in business.

exams.name: DSST Business Mathematics
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on applied business calculations including interest, discounts, depreciation, payroll and financial ratios.

exams.name: DSST Computing and Information Technology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering computer hardware, software, networking, databases and information technology fundamentals.

exams.name: DSST Criminal Justice
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering policing, courts, corrections and the structure of the American criminal justice system.

exams.name: DSST Environmental Science
aka: Environment and Humanity: The Race to Save the Planet
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on ecosystems, resource use, pollution, energy and environmental policy, formerly titled Environment and Humanity.

exams.name: DSST Ethics in America
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on major ethical traditions and their application to contemporary moral problems in American life.

exams.name: DSST Ethics in Technology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on privacy, intellectual property, computer crime and professional responsibility in technology work.

exams.name: DSST Foundations of Education
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the history, philosophy, organisation and legal framework of American schooling.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of College Algebra
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on linear and quadratic equations, inequalities, functions, exponents and logarithms.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of Counseling
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on counselling theories, the helping relationship, assessment and professional ethics.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on threats, cryptography, network defence, risk management and security governance concepts.

exams.name: DSST General Anthropology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering physical anthropology, archaeology, linguistics and cultural anthropology as four subfields.

exams.name: DSST Health and Human Development
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on nutrition, fitness, disease prevention, mental health and substance use across the lifespan.

exams.name: DSST History of the Soviet Union
aka: Rise and Fall of the Soviet Union
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering Russian revolution, Stalinism, the Cold War and the collapse of the Soviet state in 1991.

exams.name: DSST Human Resource Management
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on recruitment, selection, training, compensation, labour relations and employment law.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Business
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test surveying business forms, management, marketing, finance and the economic environment of firms.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Geography
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on population, culture, settlement, economic activity and regional geography, formerly Human Cultural Geography.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Geology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on minerals, rocks, plate tectonics, surface processes and geologic time at introductory level.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Law Enforcement
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on police history, organisation, patrol operations, investigations and constitutional limits on policing.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to World Religions
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test surveying Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, Christianity, Islam and other major religious traditions.

exams.name: DSST Lifespan Developmental Psychology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on physical, cognitive and social development from infancy through late adulthood and dying.

exams.name: DSST Management Information Systems
exams.blurb: Upper-level DANTES subject standardized test on information systems strategy, databases, systems development and IT management.

exams.name: DSST Math for Liberal Arts
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test of quantitative reasoning for non-STEM majors, covering sets, logic, probability, statistics and finance.

exams.name: DSST Money and Banking
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on money, financial markets, commercial banking, the Federal Reserve and monetary policy.

exams.name: DSST Organizational Behavior
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on motivation, group dynamics, leadership, communication and organisational culture and change.

exams.name: DSST Personal Finance
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on budgeting, credit, insurance, investing, taxes and retirement planning for individuals.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Advanced English Composition
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on rhetorical strategy, research writing, source evaluation and revision beyond first-year composition.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Finance
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on time value of money, valuation, capital budgeting, risk and return, and financial markets.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Financial Accounting
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the accounting cycle, journal entries, adjusting entries and preparation of financial statements.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Physical Science I
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering introductory physics and chemistry concepts including motion, energy, matter and waves.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Public Speaking
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on audience analysis, speech organisation, evidence, delivery and listening, including a recorded speech.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Statistics
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on descriptive statistics, probability, sampling distributions, hypothesis testing and regression.

exams.name: DSST Principles of Supervision
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the supervisory role, planning, staffing, motivating employees and managing workplace performance.

exams.name: DSST Substance Abuse
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on drug classifications, pharmacology, addiction theory, treatment approaches and prevention policy.

exams.name: DSST Technical Writing
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on audience analysis, document design, instructions, reports and the elements of technical style.

exams.name: DSST The Civil War and Reconstruction
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the causes and course of the American Civil War and the Reconstruction era that followed it.

exams.name: Modern States Freshman Year for Free
exams.blurb: Free online course programme that prepares learners for CLEP exams and issues vouchers covering the CLEP exam fee after course completion.

exams.name: TECEP Thomas Edison State University Credit by Exam
exams.blurb: Credit-by-examination program offering subject tests in business, humanities and applied fields that award Thomas Edison State University credit.

exams.name: UExcel and Excelsior College Examinations
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam program discontinued after 21 August 2022; previously earned UExcel credits can still be transferred to accepting institutions.

exams.name: AP 2-D Art and Design
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in two-dimensional design where students submit a sustained investigation and selected works instead of a written exam.

exams.name: AP 3-D Art and Design
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in three-dimensional design in which students submit sculptural and spatial works rather than sitting a written exam.

exams.name: AP African American Studies
exams.blurb: Interdisciplinary AP exam rolled out nationally in 2024 covering African American history, literature, politics and culture from African origins to today.

exams.name: AP Art History
exams.blurb: AP exam built around 250 required works of art from global cultures, testing visual analysis, contextual knowledge and comparative essay writing.

exams.name: AP Biology
exams.blurb: College-level AP exam covering cellular processes, genetics, evolution, ecology and experimental design, scored 1 to 5 for possible college credit.

exams.name: AP Calculus AB
exams.blurb: AP exam equivalent to a first-semester college calculus course, covering limits, derivatives, integrals and the fundamental theorem of calculus.

exams.name: AP Calculus BC
exams.blurb: Extended AP calculus exam covering all Calculus AB topics plus parametric, polar and vector functions, sequences and series, with an AB subscore.

exams.name: AP Chemistry
exams.blurb: AP exam equivalent to first-year college chemistry, covering atomic structure, bonding, kinetics, thermodynamics, equilibrium and acid-base reactions.

exams.name: AP Chinese Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered AP exam assessing Mandarin listening, reading, speaking and writing at roughly the fourth-semester college level.

exams.name: AP Comparative Government and Politics
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam comparing the political systems of China, Iran, Mexico, Nigeria, Russia and the United Kingdom through six core course countries.

exams.name: AP Computer Science A
exams.blurb: AP exam in object-oriented programming taught in Java, covering data types, control structures, classes, arrays, recursion and algorithm analysis.

exams.name: AP Computer Science Principles
exams.blurb: Broad AP computing exam combining an end-of-course digital test with the Create performance task submitted through the AP Digital Portfolio.

exams.name: AP Drawing
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in drawing and mark-making where students submit a sustained investigation plus selected works for external scoring.

exams.name: AP English Language and Composition
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam in rhetorical analysis, argument and synthesis writing, widely accepted as first-year college composition credit.

exams.name: AP English Literature and Composition
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam on close reading of poetry, prose fiction and drama, with three free-response essays including a literary argument.

exams.name: AP Environmental Science
exams.blurb: Interdisciplinary AP exam covering ecosystems, biodiversity, populations, energy resources, pollution and global change from a scientific perspective.

exams.name: AP European History
exams.blurb: AP exam covering European history from about 1450 to the present, including a document-based question and a long essay on historical reasoning.

exams.name: AP French Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam assessing French interpretive, interpersonal and presentational communication with recorded speaking tasks at intermediate-high proficiency.

exams.name: AP German Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam assessing German listening, reading, speaking and writing through authentic materials and recorded responses across six themed units.

exams.name: AP Human Geography
exams.blurb: Introductory AP exam on population, migration, culture, political geography, agriculture, urbanisation and economic development patterns.

exams.name: AP Italian Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam measuring Italian proficiency across listening, reading, speaking and writing, including recorded conversation and cultural comparison tasks.

exams.name: AP Japanese Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered AP exam testing Japanese listening, reading, speaking and writing, including kanji recognition and typed character input.

exams.name: AP Latin
exams.blurb: AP exam requiring translation and analysis of set passages from the Aeneid of Vergil and the Gallic War of Caesar, plus sight reading.

exams.name: AP Macroeconomics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering national income, inflation, unemployment, fiscal and monetary policy, and international trade at introductory college level.

exams.name: AP Microeconomics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering supply and demand, elasticity, production costs, market structures, factor markets and market failure at college introductory level.

exams.name: AP Music Theory
exams.blurb: AP exam combining written harmony and analysis with aural skills, melodic and harmonic dictation, and recorded sight-singing performance tasks.

exams.name: AP Physics 1: Algebra-Based
exams.blurb: Algebra-based AP exam covering kinematics, forces, energy, momentum, torque, simple harmonic motion and fluids for a first college physics course.

exams.name: AP Physics 2: Algebra-Based
exams.blurb: Algebra-based AP exam covering thermodynamics, electricity and magnetism, optics, and modern physics as a second-semester college course.

exams.name: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
exams.blurb: Calculus-based AP exam covering electrostatics, conductors and capacitors, circuits, magnetic fields and electromagnetic induction.

exams.name: AP Physics C: Mechanics
exams.blurb: Calculus-based AP exam covering kinematics, Newtonian mechanics, work and energy, momentum, rotation, oscillations and gravitation.

exams.name: AP Precalculus
exams.blurb: AP course and exam launched in 2023 covering polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric and polar functions and modelling.

exams.name: AP Psychology
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam covering biological bases of behaviour, cognition, development, social psychology, mental health and research methods.

exams.name: AP Research
exams.blurb: Second AP Capstone course assessed entirely by a 4000-5000 word academic paper, presentation and oral defence rather than a timed written exam.

exams.name: AP Seminar
exams.blurb: First AP Capstone course scored from team and individual research performance tasks plus a written end-of-course exam on source analysis.

exams.name: AP Spanish Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Most-taken AP world language exam, assessing Spanish listening, reading, writing and recorded speaking at intermediate-high proficiency.

exams.name: AP Spanish Literature and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam on a required reading list of Peninsular, Latin American and US Hispanic literature, with analysis and essays written in Spanish.

exams.name: AP Statistics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering exploratory data analysis, sampling and experimental design, probability and statistical inference, requiring a graphing calculator.

exams.name: AP United States Government and Politics
exams.blurb: AP exam on US constitutional foundations, branches of government, civil liberties, political behaviour and required Supreme Court cases.

exams.name: AP United States History
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam covering US history from 1491 to the present with a document-based question and long essay testing historical reasoning.

exams.name: AP World History: Modern
exams.blurb: AP exam covering global history from about 1200 CE to the present, emphasising comparison, causation, continuity and change across regions.
